value.rationale: The exact minimal equal-treatment outlier count and its \(m=8\) optimizer switch are natural benchmarks for a published C-complete nonweighted game family. They imply a sharp \(2^{-3m+O(\log m)}\) unrestricted coalition-error scale, exposing exponential decay of classification error alongside the previously shown \(1/(47m)\) margin loss; the result does not merely restate the model or a generic upper bound.
